notConfigured: Web account access needs its local connection settings. No credentials are sent until setup is complete.
emailSetup: Email confirmation and password recovery need the web callback to be configured before they can be enabled.
unavailable: The account service is temporarily unavailable. Your information is kept here; try again.
invalidCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
confirmEmail: Confirm your email before signing in. You can request another confirmation message below.
checkEmail: If this address is eligible, an email with the next steps will arrive. Open it in the same browser, then return to sign in.
invalidFields: Check the name, email and password fields. Passwords must have at least 6 characters when creating an account.
existingAccount: An InternMatch account already exists. Sign in instead.
noAccount: No InternMatch account was found. Create an account first.
roleUnavailable: Your account type could not be verified. Please contact support; no default role was assigned.
csrf: This request could not be verified. Open the app at its configured address and try again.
flowExpired: This confirmation or recovery session expired. Request a new link in this browser, or sign in if your email is already confirmed.
passwordUpdated: Your password was updated. Sign in with the new password.
signedOut: You are signed out of this browser.
providerUnavailable: This sign-in method is not enabled for the web yet.
sessionExists: You already have a session. Continue to your account or sign out first.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
providerSetup: Google needs web OAuth setup before activation. Apple web sign-in remains unavailable until its credentials and revocation flow are configured.
newPasswordHelp: Enter the new password after opening your recovery link in this browser.
passwordMismatch: Passwords must match and contain at least 6 characters.
workspaceNext: Your identity and account type are verified. The functional student and employer workspace pages are the next implementation phase.
appleSetup: Apple web sign-in requires its web Services ID and account revocation integration.
